digest.component_or_area: review-bot Bedrock IAM grant on the Gerrit instance role
propositions: The review-bot container needs Bedrock credentials but the instance role currently grants only SSM read and KMS decrypt with no Bedrock permission.
The grant must be a scoped inline policy in a new iam_s7.tf attached to the existing role without modifying iam.tf, per the single-owner contract.
The correct authorized action for the Converse API is bedrock:InvokeModel (plus InvokeModelWithResponseStream), not bedrock:Converse, proven by a real from-instance call.
IAM policy simulation is necessary but not sufficient; only a real from-instance call reveals which action the service actually checks, so validation must not use a wildcard-holding identity.
The policy must be scoped to Claude foundation models and inference profiles, verified by a negative control where a non-Claude model returns AccessDeniedException.
IMDS reachability from the container must be probed first, with a hop-limit contingency recorded in ADR 0046 if unreachable, without breaking opcert or Gerrit.
